read_budget.description: The most characters one `history_read` answer may carry (the stored blocks, as their canonical JSON). A larger read is refused with `too_large` and its size; it is never shortened (OR-KY-H1).

scan_budget.description: The most wall rows one `history_search` reads, newest first (and one outline). A search that stops there says `truncated_scan` with `cut_by` `scan_budget` and answers with the hits up to that point; a turn range with more rows is refused with `too_large`.

time_budget_ms.description: The most time one `history_search` spends, from the call on; a match that runs past it is interrupted and the search answers with the hits up to that point (`truncated_scan`, `cut_by` `time_budget`). Below `external_timeout_ms`, so the answer always comes before the runner would kill the child.

page_rows.description: The wall rows one page of a search reads and matches per ledger round trip; a search stops at the page that fills its `limit` (`stopped_at_limit`).

description.purpose: The model reads its own wall (GH #893): `history_search` (phrase, exact text or regular expression, newest first, with time, kind, limit and neighbour bounds, page by page and within a time budget), `history_read` (one block by its id `#<12 hex>`, or a turn range, whole or refused with `too_large`) and `history_outline` (sessions with their turn ranges and the topics their `topic` marks opened and closed, OR-KY-71), answered out of this hive's ledger alone. The model's own `history_*` calls and their answers are no hits and no blocks of a range. A read of a block TRIM released writes one `reread` mark per block and turn.
description.use_when: Inside the curator only; the parent routes `hop.tool_name` with the prefix `history_` to the hive's `in_history_call` lane and takes `tool_result` back into its collector's `in_tool`.
description.not_in_scope: No model, no embedding, no ranking: deterministic ledger reads. No other model's wall -- the ledger is this hive's. The schemas the model is offered are the curator's menu answer (`HISTORY_SCHEMAS` in `./schemas`, spliced into `CURATOR_OFFER`), not this cell's.
description.emits_meaning: tool_result: the answer to one call, one `tool_result` turn under its call id, the text a JSON object; a refusal names its code in the text and in `hop.error_code` (bad_arguments, bad_pattern, bad_range, not_found, ambiguous, too_large, unknown_tool, ledger_error; empty on an answer). A search cut short is an answer (`truncated_scan`, `cut_by` `scan_budget` or `time_budget`; `stopped_at_limit`). lstore: ledger reads, and the `reread` marks.
description.consumes_meaning: in_history_call (one `tool_call` turn, `hop.tool_call_id`, `hop.tool_name`) and the ledger's answers to its phases (search-rows, search-page, search-near, search-near-2, read-id, read-id-2, read-turns, read-range, read-range-2, read-range-3, outline, reread).
